images.prompt:
精准局部图片编辑。输入图就是要编辑的原图。保持整个画面原样：鸭子的形状、构图、位置、蓝背景、黄身体、橙色泳圈和嘴、红脸颊、黑描边都完全不变。只修改两眼内部的白色高光。
把每只黑眼睛里的白色高光画得非常大：每只白高光是一个宽约80原图像素、高约95原图像素的实心长方块，白色占该黑色眼睛内部大半，黑眼睛外轮廓大小位置不变。原图1254×1254，所以两个白块合计占整幅画约0.8%上下。不是小白点，不是细L形，不要只稍微加一格；必须是两块明显更大的亮白方块，黑眼睛的外轮廓仍围住白块，边上留黑色。只用纯白 #FFFFFF，无高光灰色。每个白块可有一个小像素阶梯角。不要修改任何其他区域。保持粗颗粒像素风格。

images.changes: Make exactly four restrained local changes to this existing turtle. (1) Reduce the RED FILLED AREA of the bow by roughly one fifth, preserving its bow silhouette, position on the head and black border. (3) Modestly enlarge the green head/shell/body fill by about45 grid cells, roughly1.25% of canvas, preserving the pose, shell divisions and limb placement rather than making a different turtle. Preserve cyan background and bottom cyan margin. Palette cyan #46D9FF, charcoal #2D2D2D, green #92EF4D, brown #65392D, red #FF525B, peach #FFCAA9. Do not introduce new accessories or change the turtle's expression.

images.prompt:
精准局部图片编辑。输入是第7关乌龟三稿-01原图。保留这只小乌龟的身份、右向侧身姿势、笑脸、龟壳分块、画风和构图。只做四处局部调整：
1. 原图红色蝴蝶结只稍微缩小，红色总面积保留原图的85%到90%，不要明显变成小蝴蝶结，不要缩成原来一半。蝴蝶结两个红色瓣的长宽各只减5%左右，位置不动，仍然很大。
2. 脸上画两小团明显的浅肤色 #FFCAA9，合计大约13个60×60格子，约占画面0.36%。两个脸颊都要明显，不能只有一个小点。
3. 绿色龟身稍微向外扩大一点，增加约45个60×60格子（1.25%整幅画），保留原来的姿态、脸、脚、龟壳线条。绿色#92EF4D。
4. 棕色沙丘底边往下延伸到离画面底边7%，左右宽度保持和原图一致，不要往左右再变宽。棕色#65392D，黑影和描边#2D2D2D。
其余都不变。背景浅蓝#46D9FF，蝴蝶结红#FF525B。原有大色块像素风，不要额外物体、文字、边框或水印。

images.changes: Apply these edits to the yawning tiger without changing its identity, expression or graphic design. (1) Remove every reddish/pink mouth interior and tongue: use only peach #FFCAA9 and charcoal #2D2D2D inside the mouth. NO RED anywhere. (2) Reduce the peach muzzle and paw regions by a combined roughly110 cells of a60×60 grid (about3.1% of entire image). Keep mouth recognizably yawning; shrink peach regions locally, not the entire tiger. (3) Make the existing thin brown horizontal log about twice as thick, adding roughly40 grid cells. Keep it horizontal under the paws. (4) Thicken the existing charcoal stripes and contours modestly, adding about60 grid cells, without new stripe designs. (5) Move the ENTIRE tiger, head and forepaws together, UP by about10% of the full canvas height; avoid clipping ears. The LOWEST ORANGE pixel must be at least47% above the bottom, equivalent to y<=53% measured down from the top. Keep the log in the lower portion and the paws resting on it. No orange wrists or tail below that boundary. Preserve original wide head, closed crescent eyes, centered yawn, symmetrical forepaws, mint background and block-pixel style. Exactly FIVE palette colors: mint #C5FFE4, orange #FF7E27, charcoal #2D2D2D, peach #FFCAA9, brown #65392D.
